author: Shivaprasad Namala

Healthy.description: Normal, vigorously growing rice leaf blade with no visible chlorosis or lesions.
Healthy.management: Continue regular nutrient management (NPK 120:50:50) and water management.

Bacterial Diseases.causal_organism: Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae (Bacterial Leaf Blight) / pv. oryzicola (Leaf Streak)
Bacterial Diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked to yellowish-white wavy marginal lesions along leaf edges, wilting (kresek).
Bacterial Diseases.treatment: Spray Streptocycline @ 1g/10L + Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 30g/10L water. Drain field water temporarily.

Fungal Diseases.causal_organism: Magnaporthe oryzae (Blast) / Bipolaris oryzae (Brown Spot) / Rhizoctonia solani (Sheath Blight)
Fungal Diseases.symptoms: Diamond/spindle-shaped lesions with grey centres (Blast) or oval brown spots with yellow halos.
Fungal Diseases.treatment: Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6g/L or Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5g/L. Avoid excess urea application.

Viral Diseases.causal_organism: Rice Tungro Bacilliform & Spherical Viruses (RTBV & RTSV)
Viral Diseases.symptoms: Stunted tillers, leaf blades turn orange-yellow from tips downwards, reduced panicles.
Viral Diseases.treatment: Control green leafhopper vectors (Nephotettix virescens) with Dinotefuran 20 SG @ 0.4g/L or Acephate 75 SP @ 1.5g/L.

pjtsau_extension_status: Aligned with Telangana Agricultural University Integrated Disease Protocols
